description: Every match_kind that runs as real logic in lib/session-ledger.mjs and lib/retrieval-hotpath.mjs, whether or not it currently has a citable AF-####. Exists because coverage tooling that only counts fables/AF-*.md undercounts implemented protection -- ten rows run and return findings with pattern_id=null, invisible to anything reading only search-index.json or leaders.json. A null pattern_id here is not weaker logic. It is logic this corpus has not yet found a real, sourced, HTTPS-backed incident to attach a stable AF-#### to. Never invent an AFI-#### to promote one of these; see CONTRIBUTING_AGENTS.md. Note fetch_error_cited appears twice, once per tool (fetch_url -> AF-0021, get_file_contents -> AF-0032): same anti-pattern, same predicate, genuinely distinct incidents and mechanisms, so two citations rather than a forced merge.

predicates.note: same match_kind and predicate function as the fetch_url row above, scoped to a different tool -- the response-integrity anti-pattern is identical, the underlying mechanism (HTML-converter content drop vs unparsed MCP resource block) is not, hence two incidents rather than one

predicates.promoted_when: a real, sourced incident of a citation token with no corresponding session tool call is found
a real, sourced incident of a claim asserted with declared support_type=unsupported is found
a real, sourced incident of an inference hop presented as a directly retrieved fact is found (would occupy the reserved AF-0034 slot from the L2 spec)
a real, sourced incident of a multi-query search_web result answering the wrong query is found (reserved AF-0029)
a real, sourced incident of a cite token attached only to satisfy a must-cite rule, not to support the adjacent claim, is found (reserved AF-0030)

predicates.note: returns pass=null, not a hard fail -- entailment of a multi-source claim cannot be verified by a pure function and is surfaced for review rather than guessed either direction
predicates.promoted_when: a real, sourced incident of a claim supported only by a union of sources, none of which individually entail it, is found (reserved AF-0028)
a real, sourced incident of a world-fact answer following a fruitless search with no negative_result object is found (reserved AF-0036)
